summary: Reviewed src/parser.ts. One P2 finding: a regex backtracks catastrophically on pathological input. Fix is straightforward. No plan-level findings in scope.

findings.title: Regex in parseHeader backtracks on nested quotes
findings.what_wrong: The regex /"([^"]*)"*/ backtracks O(2^n) on strings like '"a""a"...'. Real user logs show a hang on imported CSVs.
findings.suggested_fix: Use /"([^"]*)"/ (no trailing star) and handle escaped quotes explicitly.
findings.evidence: src/parser.ts:87; manual repro with payload in tests/fixtures/pathological.csv.
